name: Strawberry Creme
ingredients_raw: PROTEIN BLEND (FERMENTED NUTRITIONAL YEAST PROTEIN (22%) + MILK SOLIDS), EDIBLE VEGETABLE FATS (HYDROGENATED COCONUT OILS, INS 322), SWEETENER (INS 965(i)), REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), STARCH, EMULSIFIER (INS 322), EDIBLE COMMON SALT, IMPROVER ENZYME,STRAWBERRY FRUIT POWDER (0.01%), CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOR (INS 162) AND ADDED FLAVORS - NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVORING SUBSTANCES (STRAWBERRY), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (ETHYL VANILLIN).
